issue.title: test_core_vcs_log.py classify_origin/parse golden-comparison nodes are live reproducible flakes blocking the flake-baseline gate
issue.description:
Discovered while landing epic sase-jo's amend-footer follow-up fix on 2026-08-11 (workspace sase_10, base commit ccd34ae92, uncommitted changes limited to src/sase/vcs_provider/plugins/_git_core_ops.py + 3 test files -- none of which touch VCS-log parsing/classification core bindings).

REPRODUCTION: 'just check-full' passed every lint gate, SASE validation, committed-plans validation, and the full pytest test-cost lane (after a contention retry -- see sase-j0), then failed only at the final 'just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake' gate, naming 6 reproducible flakes:
- tests/test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection (already tracked: root cause is the stale tests/contract_manifest.txt covered by sase-iu, and sase-j0's notes already anticipated this exact gate symptom from that root cause)
- tests/test_core_vcs_log.py::test_classify_origin_matches_python_golden[fix: automatic-Details\n\nSASE_TYPE=sase init]
- tests/test_core_vcs_log.py::test_classify_origin_matches_python_golden[fix: legacy-Details\n\nSASE_AGENT=sase-1]
- tests/test_core_vcs_log.py::test_classify_origin_matches_python_golden[fix: tracked-Details\n\nSASE_TYPE=stitch\nSASE_BEAD=sase-1]
- tests/test_core_vcs_log.py::test_parse_computes_auto_origin_from_footer
- tests/test_core_vcs_log.py::test_parse_computes_origin_from_footer

The gate also reported "2 eligible full-run record(s) had unresolved commit order and sorted last (a cross-workspace head not present in this checkout)", confirming the reproducible-flake determination is drawing on cross-workspace historical records, not solely this checkout's own runs.

A direct isolated run immediately after ('.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_core_vcs_log.py tests/test_contract_manifest.py -v') passed all 50/50 nodes cleanly in 21.57s, including every one of the 6 flagged nodes -- matching the fails-under-full-parallel-lane / passes-in-isolation signature already on record for sase-jb and sase-j6. Machine was under heavy confirmed contention at flag time: load average 13-19, 4+ concurrent 'sase ace(run)' agent processes, an active release-mode rustc build of sase_core_rs in sibling workspace sase_12, and a root rsync hourly backup job.

WHY IT MATTERS: matches the routing sase-j4/sase-j6/sase-jb already established for gate-blocking nodes -- filed node-specific rather than corroborated onto an umbrella, since this crosses the reproducible-flake gate and blocks just check-full for every landing agent that hits these particular nodes while the machine is contended.

SCOPE: root-cause the mechanism (Rust/Python golden-comparison tests for classify_origin/parse_computes_*_origin_from_footer appear to be sensitive to full-parallel-lane resource contention, similar to sase-jb's logs-pane scroll-extremes flake) and fix it, or -- if judged baseline debt rather than a fixable mechanism -- add these 5 test_core_vcs_log.py node IDs to tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt naming this bead, per that file's header rule that additions require a filed bead. Root cause not yet investigated. The test_contract_manifest.py node in this same flag list does not need separate tracking here; its root cause is already filed as sase-iu.

VERIFY: 'just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake' passes end to end on clean master under a quiet machine, and the underlying mechanism (or baseline addition) is documented.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-j0 — same landing session's check-full run; sase-j0 tracks the earlier test-cost peak_worker_rss_kib contention failure in the same run, a distinct gate but the same root cause class (concurrent-agent machine contention on this shared host).
RELATED: sase-iu — root cause of the test_contract_manifest.py node in this same flag list (stale tests/contract_manifest.txt); already open, no separate tracking needed here.

RELATED: sase-jb — established the node-specific gate-blocking-flake filing pattern this bead follows (test_logs_pane.py scroll-extremes flake), same fails-under-parallel/passes-in-isolation signature.
RELATED: sase-j6 — the other node-specific gate-blocking flake bead filed alongside sase-jb; same routing precedent.

The five test_core_vcs_log.py nodes named on this task were in the baseline-exceeding set again: three test_classify_origin_matches_python_golden parameterizations plus test_parse_computes_auto_origin_from_footer and test_parse_computes_origin_from_footer. Independent recurrence during ref_contract_core_wire (sase-js.1) verification on 2026-08-11 in workspace sase_10: just check-full passed every lint gate, SASE validation, committed-plans validation, and the full pytest test-cost lane (28946 passed, 10 skipped) after fixing a stale ARTIFACT_REF_WIRE_SCHEMA_VERSION==4 assertion the plan's coordinated bump missed, then failed only the flake-baseline selection-health gate naming the same 6 nodes: test_contract_manifest.py::test_contract_manifest_matches_marker_selection (routed to sase-iu) plus all 5 test_core_vcs_log.py nodes on this bead.
